<script>
(function(){
  var track = document.getElementById('dos-track');
  var dotsEl = document.getElementById('dos-dots');
  var fill = document.getElementById('dos-fill');
  var slides = track.querySelectorAll('div[style*="min-width:100%"]');
  var n = slides.length;
  var cur = 0; var timer;
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
    var d = document.createElement('div');
    d.style.cssText='width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:'+(i===0?'#00d4ff':'#3a5a72')+';cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.25s;';
    d.dataset.i=i;
    d.addEventListener('click',(function(idx){return function(){goTo(idx);reset();}})(i));
    dotsEl.appendChild(d);
  }
  function goTo(i){
    cur=i;
    track.style.transform='translateX(-'+(100*cur)+'%)';
    fill.style.width=((cur+1)/n*100)+'%';
    dotsEl.querySelectorAll('div').forEach(function(d,j){
      d.style.background=j===cur?'#00d4ff':'#3a5a72';
    });
  }
  function next(){goTo((cur+1)%n);}
  function start(){timer=setInterval(next,2000);}
  function stop(){clearInterval(timer);}
  function reset(){stop();start();}
  var wrap=track.parentElement.parentElement;
  wrap.addEventListener('mouseenter',stop);
  wrap.addEventListener('mouseleave',start);
  start();
})();
</script>

<script>

(function(){
'use strict';
var canvas=document.getElementById('spark-canvas');
var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
var heroBg=document.getElementById('hero-bg');
var W,H;
function resize(){W=canvas.width=canvas.offsetWidth;H=canvas.height=canvas.offsetHeight;}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
var tMX=0.5,tMY=0.5,cMX=0.5,cMY=0.5;
document.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){tMX=e.clientX/window.innerWidth;tMY=e.clientY/window.innerHeight;});

function Arm(cfg){
  this.bx=cfg.bx;this.by=cfg.by;this.side=cfg.side;this.sc=cfg.sc||1;
  this.col=cfg.col||'#00D4FF';this.ph=cfg.ph||0;
  this.L1=0.055*this.sc;this.L2=0.042*this.sc;this.L3=0.028*this.sc;
  this.a1=-0.6;this.a2=0.4;this.a3=0.3;
  this.period=320+this.ph*80;this.t=this.ph*this.period;
  this.sparks=[];this.welding=false;this.wf=0;this.wt=0;
  this.jx=[0,0,0,0];this.jy=[0,0,0,0];
}
Arm.prototype.fk=function(){
  var bx=this.bx*W,by=this.by*H;
  var L1=this.L1*W,L2=this.L2*W,L3=this.L3*W;
  var sd=this.side==='left'?1:-1;
  this.jx[0]=bx;this.jy[0]=by;
  this.jx[1]=bx+Math.cos(this.a1)*L1*sd;
  this.jy[1]=by-Math.sin(Math.abs(this.a1))*L1*0.88;
  var a12=this.a1+this.a2*0.8;
  this.jx[2]=this.jx[1]+Math.cos(a12)*L2*sd;
  this.jy[2]=this.jy[1]+Math.sin(this.a2)*L2*0.7;
  var a123=a12+this.a3*0.6;
  this.jx[3]=this.jx[2]+Math.cos(a123)*L3*sd;
  this.jy[3]=this.jy[2]+Math.sin(Math.abs(this.a3))*L3*0.5;
};
Arm.prototype.update=function(dt){
  this.t+=dt;
  var n=(this.t%this.period)/this.period;
  var ta1,ta2,ta3,doW;
  if(n<0.30){var p=n/0.30,e=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);ta1=this.side==='left'?-0.65+e*0.28:-0.38-e*0.22;ta2=0.32+e*0.38;ta3=0.25+e*0.22;doW=false;}
  else if(n<0.62){ta1=this.side==='left'?-0.37:-0.60;ta2=0.70;ta3=0.47;doW=n>0.34;}
  else if(n<0.85){var p2=(n-0.62)/0.23,e2=p2*p2;ta1=this.side==='left'?-0.37-e2*0.38:-0.60+e2*0.30;ta2=0.70-e2*0.40;ta3=0.47-e2*0.24;doW=false;}
  else{ta1=this.side==='left'?-0.75:-0.30;ta2=0.30;ta3=0.23;doW=false;}
  var sm=0.04;
  this.a1+=(ta1-this.a1)*sm;this.a2+=(ta2-this.a2)*sm;this.a3+=(ta3-this.a3)*sm;
  this.fk();
  this.welding=doW;
  if(doW){
    this.wf=Math.max(0,this.wf-dt*0.06);
    this.wt+=dt;
    if(this.wt>5+Math.random()*4){
      this.wt=0;this.wf=1;
      var tx=this.jx[3],ty=this.jy[3];
      var ns=6+Math.floor(Math.random()*10);
      for(var i=0;i<ns;i++){
        var ang=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,spd=1+Math.random()*3.5;
        this.sparks.push({x:tx,y:ty,vx:Math.cos(ang)*spd,vy:Math.sin(ang)*spd-1.5,life:1,decay:0.035+Math.random()*0.055,sz:1+Math.random()*2,hot:Math.random()>0.45});
      }
    }
  } else {this.wf*=0.85;}
  this.sparks=this.sparks.filter(function(s){s.x+=s.vx;s.y+=s.vy;s.vy+=0.22;s.vx*=0.97;s.life-=s.decay;return s.life>0;});
};
Arm.prototype.draw=function(){
  var x0=this.jx[0],x1=this.jx[1],x2=this.jx[2],x3=this.jx[3];
  var y0=this.jy[0],y1=this.jy[1],y2=this.jy[2],y3=this.jy[3];
  var glow=this.welding?0.6+this.wf*0.4:0.25;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowBlur=16*glow;ctx.shadowColor=this.col;
  var pw=this.L1*W*0.22;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(15,25,45,0.85)';ctx.strokeStyle=this.col;ctx.lineWidth=1.2;ctx.globalAlpha=0.85;
  ctx.fillRect(x0-pw/2,y0-pw*0.35,pw,pw*0.35);ctx.strokeRect(x0-pw/2,y0-pw*0.35,pw,pw*0.35);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x0,y0);ctx.lineTo(x1,y1);ctx.strokeStyle=this.col;ctx.lineWidth=3.5;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x1,y1,4.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=this.col;ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,200,240,0.75)';ctx.lineWidth=2.8;ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x2,y2,3.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,180,220,0.9)';ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x2,y2);ctx.lineTo(x3,y3);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(200,230,255,0.6)';ctx.lineWidth=1.8;ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur=14+this.wf*20;ctx.shadowColor='#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x3,y3,2.5+this.wf*2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  if(this.wf>0.05){
    var r=ctx.createRadialGradient(x3,y3,0,x3,y3,32*this.wf);
    r.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,200,'+this.wf*0.85+')');
    r.addColorStop(0.25,'rgba(0,212,255,'+this.wf*0.45+')');
    r.addColorStop(0.6,'rgba(0,100,180,'+this.wf*0.15+')');
    r.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x3,y3,32*this.wf,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=r;ctx.fill();
    if(Math.random()>0.35){
      ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,180,'+(0.4+Math.random()*0.5)+')';ctx.lineWidth=0.7;ctx.shadowBlur=6;ctx.shadowColor='#ffffc0';
      for(var ii=0;ii<4;ii++){var a2=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,ln=3+Math.random()*14*this.wf;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x3,y3);ctx.lineTo(x3+Math.cos(a2)*ln*0.5+(Math.random()-0.5)*4,y3+Math.sin(a2)*ln*0.5+(Math.random()-0.5)*4);ctx.lineTo(x3+Math.cos(a2)*ln,y3+Math.sin(a2)*ln);ctx.stroke();}
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }
  var self=this;
  this.sparks.forEach(function(s){ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=s.life;ctx.shadowBlur=5;ctx.shadowColor=s.hot?'#FFD700':'#00D4FF';ctx.fillStyle=s.hot?'#FFE066':'#00EEFF';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.sz*s.life,0,Math.PI*2);l();ctx.restore();}});

  // animation loop
  var arms=[
    new Arm({bx:0.18,by:0.72,side:'left',sc:1.1,col:'#00D4FF',ph:0}),
    new Arm({bx:0.28,by:0.78,side:'left',sc:0.9,col:'#FFD700',ph:2}),
    new Arm({bx:0.72,by:0.72,side:'right',sc:1.1,col:'#00D4FF',ph:1}),
    new Arm({bx:0.82,by:0.78,side:'right',sc:0.9,col:'#FFD700',ph:3})
  ];
  var last=0;
  function loop(ts){
    var dt=Math.min(ts-last,32);last=ts;
    cMX+=(tMX-cMX)*0.04;cMY+=(tMY-cMY)*0.04;
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    arms.forEach(function(a){a.update(dt);a.draw();});
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
